response_limit_note: a_limit = F_allow / alpha(controlling). With alpha forcing-invariant and ~eta-invariant at the controlling mode, the response limit is a STRUCTURAL constant -> robust to the (highly uncertain) buffet level and damping that dominate the CI.
interpretation: avionics-accel is a VALID response-limit proxy for the tray interface load where coherence>0.8 (the suspension/controlling band); it DECOUPLES at the avionics-on-tray local mode (coherence drops) -> do not limit there. The tray-CG accel is the cleaner proxy (alpha ~ m_assy = 7004C effective mass); the single avionics sensor approximates it in-band.
